# Future36 chat-view ordinary-data frontier — 静态 negative

本次 **0 新 formal / 0 candidate / 0 new-related**。结论限于所读列表分桶、follow transition DTO 和实际消费者选段；明确保留旧 popout 路由因果，不代表整个锚点/滚动系统无 bug。仅写 exact `/tmp/codeshell-audit-round36-chat-view-frontier/`，不改 repo。Root 提供已冻结33的短上下文 `40d79ff`，本轮未查 Git，`formalBaseline=null`。

[anchorBuckets80行全文](/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/repo-audit-20261016/codeshell/packages/desktop/src/renderer/chat/anchorBuckets.ts:19)对指定 opaque bucket 读取稳定空数组，add 用新数组、remove/update 未命中时返回原状态，clear 只清给定非空槽；browser 子集保留有 browser payload 的 browser kind。当前 [usePanelBuckets](/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/repo-audit-20261016/codeshell/packages/desktop/src/renderer/app/usePanelBuckets.ts:175)从 active bucket 读列表，更新通过 functional state setter，发送后 clear 参数含 active 与本项目 draft slot；[PanelDock](/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/repo-audit-20261016/codeshell/packages/desktop/src/renderer/app/SessionPanelDock.tsx:210)按各 panelBucket 取列表。6个现有 test 声明和这些精确选段没有给出新的普通列表变换反例。未追所有 child 组件对数组的使用、完整发送时序或真实浏览器 echo 行为，不用手工非法 bucket/DTO 升级问题。

[followState85行全文](/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/repo-audit-20261016/codeshell/packages/desktop/src/renderer/chat/followState.ts:54)把 `distance <= threshold`作为 near，目标位置2px内的 programmatic event 保留 prev.following 并刷新 atBottom，其余 scroll 同步 following/atBottom；显式3类 rearm DTO 返回 true/true+scrollNow，跳底显示仅由 !atBottom 派生。当前 [真实 stick hook329行全文](/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/repo-audit-20261016/codeshell/packages/desktop/src/renderer/chat/stickToBottom.ts:133)在真实调用 reducer 前还有用户意图窗口、selection/reading-anchor guard；noteUserScroll 先清 programmatic 标记。不能拿孤立 reducer 的 stale-programmatic 手工输入声称 UI 会误判。实际 hook 的 jumpKey/sendEpoch/jump handler 直接 sync true/true并 snap，不是生产派发3个 rearm reducer event。[MessageStream caller](/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/repo-audit-20261016/codeshell/packages/desktop/src/renderer/MessageStream.tsx:217)传 trigger、engineSessionId及sendEpoch，并消费 showJump 和 scrollToBottom。ChatView与App选段只核实这些参数的普通传递及 hydration/new-chat 条件；1581 的 key 属于 ChatLinkResources，不能用作 MessageStream remount 反证。本轮没有建立新的普通 producer/consumer 违约，亦没有测试 DOM 事件顺序、时长、布局或滚动体验。

**明确旧因排除。** 全历史 focused query 找到 [July8原记录](/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/repo-audit-20261016/codeshell/docs/archive/todo/review-desktop-2026-07-08.md:69)：popout add/remove/update 使用 activeAnchorBucketRef 而非 origin bucket；master:67亦已转摘。当前 usePanelBuckets963–982仍可读到同类 active-ref callback 形状。本轮不重开 native/多窗口/身份路由实验，不新增ID或new-related，也不声称重新证明旧问题的完整可达性或修复状态。另 [July9 walkthrough](/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/repo-audit-20261016/codeshell/docs/archive/review-2026-07-09/02-desktop-stream-walkthrough.md:93)与 [S2/S5计划](/Users/admin/.codex/worktrees/repo-audit-20261016/codeshell/docs/archive/todo/desktop-streaming-markdown-autoscroll-plan.md:645)已明确 programmatic-scroll race及纯 reducer/DOM 胶水测试边界，不能当本轮新发现。

Round28排名两 leaf SHA 均与本轮相同，但仅有 `no-matching-source-manifest-row`和库存。缺 row 既不是未读证明，也不是已有全文语义通过；历史同版本全文语义 pin 未建立。本轮不借旧 renderer test receipts/pass，不将 source文字里的断言、SSR fixture、callback或 event listener 当执行。原指令已在 preceding future35全文读过，本次只核相同bytes/SHA，新增指令语义读行计0。

全 `docs/`、`bugs/` MD 行与递归 JSON value scalars（keys排除）gate纳入已冻33，精确排34/35/36，含 exact archive/_archive：**3137文件 =1321MD+1816JSON；718308 strings /1064468 scalars；169 archive paths；0 parse errors**。canonical inventory SHA `0534950d949663e1eb0ac730c6c1ddf357b902a5281b5965bd674649682acf07`，与 earlier future35库存逐项相同（0新增/移除/共享漂移）。这是dated filesystem byte capture，不是Git原子快照。

首组 targets/ordinary-contract/old-failed =34/142/42 occurrences，cap100保留34/100/42；全部34 target和42 old-failed contexts已读，宽泛142不作语义读尽声明。随后同3137清单 no-cap focused real-helper-symbols/known-follow-cause/known-bucket-cause =3/29/38，共70 contexts全部保留并读完，二次bytes漂移0。匹配计数不等于独立根因或全文语义覆盖。详见 [history.json](/tmp/codeshell-audit-round36-chat-view-frontier/history.json)、[focused-history.json](/tmp/codeshell-audit-round36-chat-view-frontier/focused-history.json)、[prior-coverage.json](/tmp/codeshell-audit-round36-chat-view-frontier/prior-coverage.json)。

[Source manifest](/tmp/codeshell-audit-round36-chat-view-frontier/source-manifest.json)列11个 product/test pin，5 full /6 selected，共1147已读行（包含独立列出的 rg single-line navigation），另53行历史MD选段、2个排名JSON rows。产品pin均在本轮 source 阅读前，finish SHA不变；3份历史MD dedicated pins晚于 history excerpts，initialBeforeSemanticRead诚实为null。只读相邻权限或来源文字不构成 authority审查。

17个现有 test **文字声明**（anchor6、follow11，其中一条为3-kind循环模板）0执行。**0 helper/产品/import/测试/React/browser/DOM/scroll/native/CLI/network/model/权限或身份实验；0 Git、0 repo写。** [Validation](/tmp/codeshell-audit-round36-chat-view-frontier/validation.json)披露 focused metadata 首次yield时wrapper未保留session id/最终shell exit未知，后续只读取其已完成JSON并分段读contexts，未重跑该扫描或产品；没有把元数据局限隐去或折算产品通过。

Verification: `approval-queue.test.tsx` renders actual ChatView with req-A and req-B, approves req-A, then checks req-B's `second image` description is visible, `仅本次批准` has disappeared, `已批准` appears, and decision call count remains 1 (1 pass / 5 assertions). Confidence: high.

## D5 [P2] A delayed plugin command overwrites the next conversation's unsent draft

Primary location: `packages/desktop/src/renderer/ChatView.tsx:981-987`; destination selection at `packages/desktop/src/renderer/App.tsx:376-383`.

Trigger: run `/demo:review src/A.ts` in conversation A; while command expansion IPC is pending, switch to B, which already contains an unsent draft. ChatView remains mounted and only checks mountedRef after the await. Parent's draft setter chooses activeBucketRef.current when the promise completes.

Impact: A's expansion replaces B's entire unsent draft; A retains the original command. This is actual user draft loss, separate from D2's stale synchronous attachment state. Similar identity handling is worth checking for transcription and image staging.

Verification: second case in `composer-session.test.tsx` renders actual ChatView and uses the same dynamic-ref parent setter as App. Expander starts with `{sessionId:"A"}`; after switching, B's `B 已经写好的重要草稿` becomes `A 的 review 命令展开内容`, while A stays `/demo:review src/A.ts` (1 relevant pass / 5 assertions). Confidence: high.

Suggested correction: capture the source bucket and draft revision at invocation, write results to that source draft, and preserve text edited during expansion.

Total: **7 targeted tests / 51 assertions / 0 failures / 0 skipped**. This is not a full-suite rerun. Each was run separately from the latest workspace with `node scripts/run-bun-test-shard.mjs --timeout 15000 /tmp/codeshell-review-20261012-desktop-quality-round10/<name>.test.tsx`. Runner completion was checked in every final log. The project fixture's two expected Git “not a git repository” probes concern owned plain temporary directories; they are not product failures or failed tests.

Safety and limits: guarded runner supplies an isolated real HOME and removes inherited provider credentials. Fixtures install fetch/http/https/net/tls connection guards **before local Core-facing dynamic imports**. Plugin writes touch only isolated user settings; project stores use owned temporary directories. No real models/APIs, third-party downloads, user plugins, microphone, browser account or running user service. UI tests use the repository mini DOM and actual React handlers, not a real Electron/browser click session. Network guards cover the tested in-process APIs, not an OS network sandbox.

## R04 — retain: delayed expansion has a live route to B's draft

Primary evidence: `packages/desktop/src/renderer/ChatView.tsx:978–987` and `packages/desktop/src/renderer/App.tsx:376–383`.

Production App renders its main ChatView without a session identity key (`App.tsx:2442`); changing engineSessionId/sendBucket keeps that component mounted. Expansion captures A's pluginCommandTarget and awaits IPC at ChatView:981, then checks only mountedRef before calling setDraft(:986–987). App's setter picks activeBucketRef.current *when applying the update*, which is now B. The actual IPC handler `packages/desktop/src/main/index.ts:3989–4000` awaits rendererConfigurationCwd before expansion; even a local command has a real asynchronous IPC/authority boundary. This does not depend on an external model or network operation.

The local expanding flag disables composer controls (`ChatView.tsx:838–839`), but does not block sidebar navigation: App:2195 calls navigateFromSidebar; that callback comes from useResponsiveSidebar (`App.tsx:234`) and simply executes or defers the navigation until drawer close (`packages/desktop/src/renderer/app/useResponsiveSidebar.ts:46–55`). It has no knowledge of ChatView's expansion state. Thus “A expansion pending, switch directly to B containing a pre-existing draft, successful late result” is reachable. Do not claim the user must type B's draft during the disabled interval.

Original portable `reproductions/desktop/composer-session.test.tsx` second case proves A target and B overwrite (5 assertions). New controls establish normal same-session completion updates A only; React unmount before resolution leaves both source command and B draft intact. Those guards are real but do not protect same-mounted session changes. A retains its original slash command, while the overwritten prior B draft is not restored by the success path. Confidence high.
